stories.title: Government 'determined' to deport grooming gang leader
stories.summary: Shabir Ahmed, 73, was released from prison in July after 14 years behind bars.

stories.title: Failings contributed to arson attack deaths, family tells inquest
stories.summary: The family of a woman who was murdered, along with her four children, say police failed to intervene.

stories.title: Man who murdered wife and hid body under bed jailed
stories.summary: Kyle Howard, 37, of Rochdale, killed Keeley Aspinall in "a devastating act of domestic abuse", police say.

stories.title: Police investigate death of boy, 3, after nursery incident
stories.summary: The boy died in hospital three days after an incident at Cosy Toes Nursery in Middleton, police say.

stories.title: Ex-football boss who plotted to rape man's wife admits child abuse image offences
stories.summary: Karl Lindsay previously pleaded guilty to offences relating to the drugging and raping of a man's wife.

stories.title: Six more arrests in murder probe over stab death
stories.summary: Seven people are now in custody over the death of a 27-year-old man in north Manchester.

stories.title: Assault inquiry dropped after suspect fails to attend interview
stories.summary: Emily Geer says she has been left "demoralised" after being informed that the case had been dropped.

stories.title: Harry Styles, Billie Eilish, Sam Fender and Cher to headline Glastonbury 2027
stories.summary: The festival will also host Cher in the Sunday "legends" slot, the unofficial fourth headline set.

stories.title: Police now using scrapped Clean Air Zone cameras
stories.summary: A public consultation backed the transfer to police, but respondents also raised concerns about privacy.

stories.title: York City player pleads not guilty over alleged punch of Rochdale fan
stories.summary: Hiram Boateng has pleaded not guilty to a public order charge at Manchester Magistrates' Court.

stories.title: 'Predatory' doctor should have been barred, High Court rules
stories.summary: A decision to suspend a doctor for 12 months has been overruled by a judge on appeal.

stories.title: Rooney says he considered taking his own life at Man Utd
stories.summary: Wayne Rooney says he considered taking his own life during his playing days at Manchester United and was "speaking to a therapist to try and figure out what was up".
